data.short_meaning: Family; one who supports a family (ʿāʾilah)
data.long_meaning: Aaila (عائلة) is the Arabic ʿāʾilah, 'family, dependents' and also 'one who provides for and supports a family'. It comes from the root ʿ-w-l, as in ʿāla, 'to support, to maintain'.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aaila total 15, reducing to 6. Number 6 is traditionally associated with its own character. This is an interpretive tradition, not a factual claim.
